project: Knowledge-Tracing-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Exercise Selection
phase: Phase 7 — Policy Audit, Advanced RL Improvements & Verified Integration

experiments_executed.purpose: Verify baseline test suite and live HTTP API routes without modifications.
Investigate why forgetting_aware and weakest_bkt_kc produced identical Phase 6 numbers.
experiments_executed.hypothesis: Uniform start at t=0 makes retention decay a monotonic transform of raw prior mastery.
experiments_executed.findings: Mathematically confirmed. Staggered practice intervals differentiate rankings.

experiments_executed.purpose: Decompose reward terms and evaluate Pearson correlation with true mastery gain.
experiments_executed.findings: Static entropy accounts for 27.6% - 29.3% of reward. Aligned reward boosts prereq_aware_weakest correlation to r=+0.78.

experiments_executed.purpose: Evaluate 7-day delayed retained mastery and active gross learning across 8 policies.
experiments_executed.findings: prereq_aware_weakest achieved best delayed retained gain (-0.0459 +/- 0.0188).

experiments_executed.purpose: Evaluate out-of-distribution robustness across 4 conditions (unseen seeds, T=40, cohort shifts).
experiments_executed.findings: prereq_aware_weakest outperformed Dueling DQN across all 4 out-of-distribution conditions.

experiments_executed.purpose: Evaluate 10 policies including newly implemented LinUCB Contextual Bandit.
experiments_executed.findings: composite_adaptive achieved highest reward (36.04), prereq_aware_weakest achieved highest gross learning (+2.27).
